description: Switch bandit allocation on or off for one of your stored experiments, and set its floors: pass experiment_key and bandit_enabled, and optionally min_weight_pct (1 to 50, the least traffic any arm keeps) and control_min_weight_pct (1 to 90, the least control keeps). The floors have to fit the number of arms. Read the result with get_experiment_stopping. Answers "not enabled" until sequential testing is switched on for your workspace. Needs a claimed Last Price credential for the workspace that owns the experiment. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

control_min_weight_pct.description: The least traffic control keeps, in percent.

experiment_key.description: The experiment key, as created (lowercase letters, digits and underscores).

min_weight_pct.description: The least traffic any arm keeps, in percent.

name: set_experiment_bandit
